headline: U.S. Air Force Global Strike Command conducted a test launch of an unarmed 'Minuteman III' intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM) from Vandenberg Space Force Base, California, at 11:01 p.m. Pacific Time last night. The Air Force says test launches assess the entirety of the ICBM enterprise and provide data to inform ICBM sustainment, engineering and lifecycle analysis. It has completed over 300 Minuteman III test launches. The test was designated 'Glory Trip 257', was scheduled years ago and is not in response to world events, according to the Air Force. Flight tracking data from @flightradar24 suggests a U.S. Navy E-6B Mercury was involved. Secretary Hegseth will also be on hand for the delivery of the first C-130 Hercules transport aircraft to the Colombian Armed Forces as part of a wider U.S. military assistance program that could include two more aircraft.

headline: Presidents Donald J. Trump, Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping have met today at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit in Shenzhen, China. Putin and Trump shook hands and briefly exchanged a few words during a group photo session with Xi ahead of a reception for the delegation heads, according to video from RT. Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said Putin and Xi discussed ending Russia’s war against Ukraine in their own talks. The three are set to meet in Shenzhen alongside the APEC leaders’ meeting.
